correctness.rationale: In a selected K_r clique plus n independent leaves, the longest simple (not necessarily induced) path on p clique and q leaf vertices has order min(p+q,2p+1): leaves must be separated by clique vertices, and alternating with adjacent clique insertions achieves the bound. Thus the t-path-free faces satisfy min(p+q,2p+1)<t for r,n>=2,t>=5. The closed star at a chosen leaf v is a cone, and its complementary simplices are exactly size t−1 and p>=ceil((t−1)/2), with boundaries entirely in the star. The quotient is a wedge of B(r,n,t) spheres S^{t−2}; the relative integral oriented facet chains yield the S_r×S_{n−1} exterior-power direct sum. For S_r×S_n the augmented Hopf trace on invariant faces and cycle-polynomial weights gives the stated rational character, and each p>=2 wedge exterior power has no S_r invariant via a transposition of two selected clique labels. Independent separate graph-DFS enumeration and mod-two chain ranks agree for four small (r,n,t) triples; that does not prove the quantified integral statement. Edge cases t>r+n and B=0 are covered by the cone.
